title: Fix Core path isolation, token/stop/audit/uninstall bugs, and IPC bus dynamic rendezvous
goal: Prevent nested .susi dirs via workspace_state_dir, unify host_token_path resolution, accurately report systemd unit stops in susi stop/restart, filter #[cfg(test)]/substring false positives in susi audit, guard susi uninstall to primary instance, clean failed reflex synthesis sources, make IpcPlaneBus track dynamic SUSI_HOME changes, and isolate susi-gmcp unit tests from live host ~/.susi.

reuse.reason: Reuses susi_paths::{workspace_state_dir,host_token_path,is_primary_instance}, susi_error::redact::secret_match_starts, compliance::CfgTestSkipper, and IpcPlaneBus dynamic slot tracking across all affected crates.
reuse.searched: Checked susi-paths, susi-config, susi-core, susi-daemon, susi-sandbox-client, susi-tools, susi-gawd, susi-gawd-agents, susi-gawd-swarm, susi-gemi, susi-gmcp, and src/cli.
